firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently extracted DNA from an amber-trapped mosquito goes first. If nobody has done that, whoever most recently visited a theme park starts.
houseFallback: If the official criteria leave a tie or nobody qualifies, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Give the starter the First Player Token and arrange the opening turn order clockwise. That player rolls the DNA dice and takes the first research turn.
The theme-park criterion is the rulebook’s official fallback, not an extra rule invented by this site.

Later rounds use ascending victory-point order, starting with the lowest score. Players tied on points keep their relative order from the preceding round; this does not break a tie during initial setup.
This answer covers multiplayer setup in Rulebook 2.0. The same manual includes a separate solo mode.
